traits.note: The Lucid key to the flowering plant families, with FloraBase and the Smithsonian's family text, as search results quote them (the pages themselves were not read): corolla sympetalous, usually 5-merous, mostly zygomorphic and commonly two-lipped; ovary superior on a nectar disc, of 2 fused carpels; stamens 4 (didynamous) or 2, on the corolla tube.
